resources.string: Hold nothing back - tap Record, speak for a few seconds, then pick Male or Female and preview the result.
Your microphone is morphed in real time and played out of this device. Use headphones to avoid feedback, or let the speaker broadcast your changed voice to a nearby mic.
Android gives the microphone to one app at a time. Live morphing therefore works while VoiceMorph is the app in front of you - background apps receive silence while you are here.

Android hands the microphone exclusively to the game that is on screen (PUBG, Free Fire, COD Mobile…), and Android has no virtual-microphone API, so no app can inject a changed voice into a game in real time without root. The method that genuinely works everywhere is acoustic broadcast: VoiceMorph plays your morphed clip out loud at max volume and the game microphone picks it up.

1. Record and morph your voice in Studio.\n2. Join voice chat in your game.\n3. Press Broadcast - a 3 second countdown gives you time to switch back to the game, then the clip plays at maximum volume.
